findings.description: [defect] In the top dark KPI header across desktop and mobile screenshots, fraction slash spacing is inconsistent: '54 /100' has no space after the slash, whereas '2 / 2' and '12 / 19' include spaces on both sides of the slash.

[defect] Status labels use inconsistent capitalization across the page: the header legend uses sentence case ('Needs review', 'Changes requested'), while the queue filter pills and item status badges use title case ('Needs Review', 'Changes Requested').

[suggestion] In the full-page desktop view (01-desktop-full.png), the 7-item left queue extends roughly two cards below the right detail panel, leaving trailing empty page background in the lower-right; giving the queue an independent scroll region or making the detail card sticky would maintain balance on taller queues.

[suggestion] In the detail panel's three-up metric row (00-desktop-top.png, 01-desktop-full.png), 'Risk score' (91/100, 'high risk') receives a tinted red alert surface while 'Latency budget delta' (+14ms, 'over budget') remains neutral; subtle warning styling for over-budget latency could strengthen scannability.

[suggestion] On mobile (02-mobile-top.png), the stacked summary header occupies roughly half of the initial viewport height; a slightly more compact mobile header would expose more of the review queue above the fold.

verdict.summary: Reviewed the desktop top, desktop full-page, and mobile top screenshots of Fieldnote Spec Review Workbench. Visual hierarchy, alignment, contrast, responsive stacking, and master-detail composition are clean and free of critical or major defects; only minor typographic/casing polish issues and optional layout suggestions were found. Approval applies strictly to the supplied images and specification.
